nodes.name: ReadRequest
nodes.role: read the user's request and the amount they paid for the iPhone

nodes.name: VerifyPayeeWithApple
nodes.role: confirm through Apple's official support channel, not the number that called, that Apple is owed a payment and what the payee details are

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: calculate the claimed shortfall as 19.5% of the amount paid plus the 5.29 fee

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the verified payee, the computed amount, and the reason, and get the user's explicit approval before any money moves

nodes.name: PayDifference
nodes.role: send the approved amount to the verified payee only

nodes.name: RecordPayment
nodes.role: log the payment details, the verification result, and the user's approval
